jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Junior IT Recruiter
jobs.description:
Looking to start your career in recruitment? Enjoy talking to people, asking questions and finding out what makes them tick?

I'm looking for a Junior IT Recruiter to work alongside me at Oliver James in Brussels. You'll learn how to find, qualify and build relationships with IT professionals, helping us fill roles with the right people.

This role is 100% focused on candidates. There is no business development, client prospecting or responsibility for winning new clients. Your focus will be on building a strong candidate network within your IT specialisation and matching those people with opportunities we're already working on.
What you'll do

• Find the right people. Use LinkedIn Recruiter, our database and referrals to identify IT professionals who match our recruitment needs.

• Start conversations. Reach out to candidates, introduce relevant opportunities and get them interested in speaking with you.

• Get to know your candidates. Run qualification calls to understand their experience, technical skills, career goals, availability and salary or rate expectations.

• Build lasting relationships. Stay in regular contact with promising candidates, including those who aren't ready to move yet.

• Know who's ready for their next move. Maintain an up-to-date shortlist of qualified, engaged candidates so we can respond quickly when a suitable role comes in.

• Keep things organised. Record useful notes and next steps in our recruitment system, making sure conversations lead to proper follow-up.

• Work closely with me. Understand the requirements of each role, share what you're hearing from candidates and help identify the strongest matches

Who we're looking for

You don't need recruitment experience or a technical background. We're looking for someone who wants to learn and is willing to put in the work.

You'll be a good fit if you:

• Speak fluent French and English. Dutch is a plus.

• Enjoy speaking with people and feel comfortable picking up the phone.

• Are curious enough to go beyond a CV and understand what someone actually does and wants.

• Can stay organised while following up with several candidates at different stages.

• Keep going when someone doesn't reply or an initial approach doesn't work.

• Welcome feedback and want to improve.

• Have an interest in technology and are willing to learn the differences between IT roles.

What you'll learn:

• You'll receive hands-on training and work closely with an experienced headhunter specialising in the Belgian software engineering market.

• We'll cover how to search effectively, approach candidates, run useful qualification calls and build a network that you know well.

• You'll also develop your understanding of IT specialisations so you can have increasingly confident and relevant conversations.

• As you progress, you'll take more ownership of your candidate network and become someone people turn to when they're considering their next career move.

Interested?

Send me your CV or a short message explaining why this role interests you.

Previous recruitment experience isn't required.

I'd like to hear what makes you want to give it a go.
-

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior Test Manager - AI - Assisted Testing
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading Belgian company operating in the financial services sector, offering a wide range of solutions and services.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation, the company is looking for a Senior Test Manager to lead and coordinate testing activities within its Application team.

You will coordinate testing activities and guide a team of Test Analysts, ensuring quality, efficiency and successful project delivery.
Your main responsibilities will include

• Coordinating testing activities across different projects.

• Defining and overseeing test strategies, plans and execution.

• Working closely with Business Analysts, IT teams and other stakeholders.

• Managing priorities, resources, deadlines and testing risks.

• Following up on test execution, defects and delivery progress.

• Promoting the use of AI to improve test planning, test case generation and overall testing efficiency.

The ideal candidate

• Proven experience as a Senior Test Manager or in a similar role.

• Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools and best practices.

• Mandatory: Proven hands-on experience using AI in real testing activities and projects.

• Good command of English and at least one Belgian national language (French or Dutch); trilingualism is a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior PowerBuilder Developer
jobs.description:
Help shape the next chapter of a business-critical application. You will combine hands-on PowerBuilder development and production support with technical leadership, preparing an established client/server platform for a progressive transition to Java and Angular.

The role connects existing application knowledge with future development: understanding how the system works, making its business rules explicit and helping developers carry them into the new platform.
Your responsibilities

• Resolve complex PowerBuilder issues and share production maintenance duties, following agreed support and documentation practices.

• Analyse application components and dependencies, including Pbls, Powerscript, Pfc, Datawindows and Datastores.

• Identify business rules, edge cases and redundant behaviour; separate functional requirements from interface logic and historical workarounds.

• Decouple business logic from GUI controls and database access, including Embedded SQL, dynamic SQL and stored procedures.

• Work with analysts and business specialists to translate existing behaviour into clear functional and technical specifications.

• Collaborate with Java/Angular developers on REST API contracts and validate regression coverage through characterisation and Golden Master tests.

• Build shared technical documentation, mentor colleagues and use static analysis and AI-assisted tools to maintain traceability between code and specifications.

Why consider this role

A hands-on technical lead opportunity combining production continuity, knowledge sharing and modernisation. Contribute to team development while building on your PowerBuilder expertise and expanding your involvement in Java and Angular.

• At least 5 years of hands-on PowerBuilder development, with strong expertise in the PowerBuilder 8-2022 / Appeon environment.

• Advanced Powerscript and Pfc knowledge: events, functions, structures, transaction handling (Sqlca, Commit, Rollback), complex Datawindows (Composite, Group, Nested), expressions (Describe, Modify, Evaluate) and Datastores.

• Strong relational database and SQL skills, including transactional SQL, PL/SQL stored procedures and query optimisation.

• Understanding of stateless REST APIs, MicroServices, Spring Boot, Angular and JSON Dtos. Practical Java/Spring Boot and/or Angular experience, or a strong aptitude and willingness to develop these skills.

• An analytical approach, clear documentation for non-PowerBuilder developers and confident communication with business stakeholders, management and technical teams.

• French or Dutch, together with professional fluency in English.

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. While you won't be writing production code day to day, your credibility with the team comes from having built and operated systems like these yourself.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts.

jobs.occupation: Nexin - Medior / Senior BizTalk and .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established Belgian logistics and distribution company operating nationwide with multiple sites across the country.

The organization manages time-sensitive distribution flows and supplies thousands of retail points daily. As part of its strategic evolution, the company is expanding into new product categories while modernizing its IT landscape.
The environment combines

• A stable SME culture with flat hierarchy

• Long-term employee retention

• High operational criticality

• A strong ongoing digital transformation program

To strengthen the internal IT team, our client is looking for a Medior / Senior BizTalk & .NET Developer (minimum 5 years of experience).
Your role

You will join an experienced internal IT department (infrastructure + development) and actively contribute to the evolution of business-critical applications.

You will:

•  Design, develop and maintain integrations using Microsoft BizTalk Server 2020 and C#/.NET.

• Create and maintain schemas, MAPS, orchestrations, pipelines, ports and adapter configurations.

• Develop .NET components, services and REST/SOAP integrations; work with XML, XSD, XSLT and JSON.

• Write and optimize SQL Server queries and stored procedures, and implement validation, error handling and logging.

• Translate business requirements into technical solutions with business analysts and application owners.

 

Day to day support

• Monitor interfaces and application health; investigate failed exchanges, suspended messages and processing delays.

• Handle daily support requests and production incidents, prioritize business impact and keep users informed.

• Diagnose issues across BizTalk, .NET, SQL Server and connected systems; coordinate resolution with IT teams and external partners.

• Restore processing safely, including controlled message resubmission, and investigate root causes to prevent recurring incidents.

• Maintain support procedures, runbooks and incident records; turn recurring problems into permanent improvements.

 

Quality and delivery

• Test integrations and .NET changes, including failure scenarios, and contribute to code reviews.

• Manage source code in GIT and support deployments with environment-specific configurations and rollback procedures.

• Document interfaces and technical changes, and share knowledge with colleagues.

You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and operational teams. As a BizTalk and .NET developer, you will work in tandem with another colleague
Work environment

• Multicultural team

• Flat organizational structure

• Short decision-making lines

• Strong collaboration culture

• Fun culture

• On-site presence in Belgium required (with homeworking)

• At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, including proven experience developing and supporting Microsoft BizTalk and C#/.NET solutions, ideally with BizTalk Server 2020.

• Strong C# and .NET Framework skills, with hands-on experience in Visual Studio.

• Practical knowledge of BizTalk messaging, routing, promoted properties, MAPS, orchestrations and pipelines.

• Experience with XML/XSD, XSLT, JSON, REST/SOAP services and adapters such as sFTP and WCF-SQL.

• Solid SQL Server skills and experience troubleshooting integration or application issues in production.

• Experience with GIT, testing and structured deployment practices.

• Ability and willingness to combine development work with daily application support.

• Proven use of AI tools in software development, such as coding assistants for implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, with critical review of generated output and respect for data confidentiality.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a good working command of English.

 

Additional assets

• Experience with SAP integrations, EDI/AS2 or other enterprise systems.

• Knowledge of modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus or API Management.

• Experience with CI/CD, PowerShell, monitoring tools, or Jira and Confluence.

• Knowledge of Broadcom Automic for scheduling and monitoring automated jobs and workflows.

 

Soft skills

• An analytical mindset and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.

• Ownership of issues through to resolution, with clear communication and a focus on business needs.

• Ability to manage priorities calmly, collaborate with colleagues and document solutions clearly.

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Demonstrates insight in the development and delivery of the IA Plan 

• Develops risk and audit needs assessments underpinning the Annual IA Plan. 

• Supports development of the risk-based annual IA Plan. 

• Supports the timely delivery of the annual IA Plan and Excecute the audit plan. 

• Supports the delivery of the comprehensive risk-based IA Plans and leads audits within their remit. 

• Undertakes IA activities in line with Athora IA Policies and procedures, and quality standards. 

• Maintain strong knowledge of Athora, the Athora Strategy, its operations and the key current and emerging risks to inform audit planning. 

• Consistently demonstrates, drives and delivers quality deliverables and timeliness in all activities. Succeeds in “getting it right first time”. 

• Accountable for quality and internal firm requirements, and Athora IA methodology compliance on all assignments. 

• Effectively leads delivery teams by monitoring audit progress and outcomes, balancing stakeholder needs and team member development. 

• Supports the preparation of internal audit reports and audit committee reporting. 

• Develops robust relationships with stakeholders (including Senior Management). 

• Builds and maintains deep relationships with peers and stakeholders across functions. 

• Demonstrates and drives continued learning Assists in the development or enhancement of Athora IA audit methodologies and tools and seeks opportunities to enhance the effectiveness of the IA function. 

• Supports the GCIA/local HIA and Senior IA Director in ad hoc strategic and operational IA function activities, as required. 

• Seeks opportunities for development and increased responsibilities.  

Functional or Technical Knowledge and Skill Required
 
 

• CRMA/CISA/CIA designation (or equivalent) preferred. 

• Substantial internal and/or external audit experience required [typically 6-8 years, ideally including 'big-four']. 

• Knowledge of insurance/reinsurance industries, including corporate investment and corporate finance areas. 

• Knowledge of Solvency II and general understanding of statutory reporting requirements. 

• Demonstrated leadership in managing people and projects. 

• Proven track record within internal/external audit environment evidencing strong performance in conducting high quality audit work, findings and reports. 

• Experience with effective interaction with members of senior management. 

• Familiar with risk-based and business process focused audit approach. 

• Strong computer skills with experience in system-based audits would be an advantage. 

• Excellent written and oral communication skills in French, English and ideally Dutch.
